messages:
kevin: Quick report: ran rwd-v7-int6-lite across 4k mixed-slice probes. TL;DR: latency wins, cost down ~26%, but doc-fidelity hit on long-synth slice.

lia: numbers?

kevin: p50 -13%, p95 -17% on our A100 canary. hallucination_est baseline 2.7% -> int6 4.9% (abs +2.2%). agreement with baseline scoring 90.5%.

eval-bot: upload: //internal/snapshots/1767777001/rwdv7-int6-sample.log. CI on hallucination delta +/-0.6%.

sam: That delta breaches our 1.0% soft threshold. Recommend no >1% traffic until mitigations. Possible mitigations: rerank to fp16 baseline, hybrid quant (body fp16), or post-process calibration.

kevin: Agree. Proposed immediate steps: cancel outgoing 5% soft-promote; launch 0.1% canary with shadow + rerank fallback; run hybrid-int6-body-fp16 shadow job. Gate config draft: target_pct=0.1, duration=24h, metrics=[hall_abs_delta(1.0%), agreement(93%), p95_latency_delta(50ms)], auto_fallback=true.

lia: add avg-logprob-delta as a secondary signal and alert if CI lower bound > 0.8%. Also include slice "multi-doc synthesis" as critical.

devops-bot: rollout pending cancel request acknowledged.

kevin: I'll file RL-3720 and attach eval artifacts + rollback snippet: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-3720 && redwood route set default rwd-v7-fp16`.

sam: I'll prototype rerank hook (fp16 scorer) and a confidence throttle (.75 threshold). ETA 8h.

lia: If hybrid brings hall_abs_delta < 0.6% and agreement > 94% we can consider staged bump. Otherwise rollback.

kevin: Thanks. I'll post canary URL when live. :eyes:
